sentences.en: The Earth will exit the debris field in late August.
sentences.zh: 地球将在八月底退出这片碎片带。

sentences.en: First they saw the debris then they looked at each other.
sentences.zh: 他们先是看到了碎片，然后互相看了看。

sentences.en: The cupboards were overflowing with the accumulated debris of several years.
sentences.zh: 橱柜里堆满了多年来的各种杂物。

mnemonic: 发音记忆：“堆玻璃”→一堆碎玻璃→废墟
